title: What Makes Life Beautiful? - Nautilus
gist: An excerpt from a Nautilus piece on beauty recounts evolutionary psychologist Nick Humphrey meeting a Turkish family of eight children with a genetic condition who walked on all fours, scorned by villagers yet loving toward each other.

insights.claim: Evolutionary psychologist Nick Humphrey met a family in Turkey with eight children who, due to a genetic disease, could only move on all fours, and were studied and filmed as an example of human development.
insights.speaker: Kristen French
insights.so_what: Anecdote used as a lens on human development and meaning.
insights.locator: Many years ago, evolutionary psychologist Nick Humphrey

insights.claim: Villagers scorned and threw stones at the children, yet the children seemed to love each other deeply, and the local imam told the parents their disabilities were a gift from Allah, a test.
insights.speaker: Kristen French
insights.so_what: Illustrates how communities impose religious meaning on suffering.
